subject: math
description: Construct and interpret cumulative frequency tables, cumulative histograms, and ogives for grouped data.
learningObjectives: Construct less-than cumulative frequency tables from grouped data
Plot and interpret ogives using class boundaries and running totals
Use cumulative displays to answer at most, at least, median, and percentile questions
Distinguish ordinary frequency from cumulative frequency
Write context-based conclusions from cumulative frequency displays
prerequisites: Read frequency tables and simple graphs
Use fractions and percents to describe part of a group
Understand class intervals and ordered data
